verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents its own Transfers and Batch Transfers features for paying suppliers, so vendor payouts are a native capability. The evidence never names domestic ACH or wire rails, so how far this story's specific payment methods are supported is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of domestic ACH and domestic wire payment methods, US rail details such as timing and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can send domestic ACH and wire payments to vendors

citations.quote: Airwallex Transfers allows you to move funds across the globe easily to your suppliers, employees, contractors and/or own bank accounts.
Easily manage multiple transfers to recipients in various countries/regions and in various currencies to multiple beneficiaries for payroll runs and supplier payments.
Airwallex Batch Transfers allows you to create multiple transfers in bulk to streamline your transaction processing and reconciliation
